sys_script_include.description:
This script is created for MSSCUSTODY-2530 which compares the band limit w.r.t nominal settlement amount and settlement amount in USD
Code Description:
The code evaluates for any Checker task of trade outcomes with "Settle or Confirm Trade" if the selected user holds the respective access groups and USD authorization limits to work on the task
Client Scripts Utlizing the script: 1) Check Band Limit on Change of Assignee 2) Check Band Limit on Load of Assignee
sys_script_include.name: checkBandLimit
